checks.note: The short_clips fact reports all seven segments narrated in en, es and zh-Hans with the longest narration 33.92 s (zh-Hans chapter 6), under the 35 s ceiling; every language's longest is es 31.36 s and en 24 s. Running times with the title card stay in the same range, and the chapter lists in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png show all seven chapters with per-chapter times from 0:10 to 0:36, no 2.5-minute single clip.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and found no match. Nothing owl-like or mascot-like appears in any screenshot: the four panels in guide-en-desktop.png and its phone, Spanish and Mandarin counterparts are the head with the mastoid dressing, a hand pulling the bandage off with a direction arrow, the incision behind the ear with steri-strips, and a magnified ear labelled "Check for tape" - surgical site and anatomy, as asked.

The narrator fact lists one voice, George, for each of the three narrated languages, so one narrator per language and no character. No screenshot shows a talking character; the picture panels carry only numerals, an arrow and a short label.

The subtitles fact lists captions for all seven segments in en, es and zh-Hans. At desktop width the caption band under the picture carries the spoken sentence with the current word highlighted and a Captions / Subtitulos / 字幕 checkbox (guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png). At phone width the transcript under the player is the caption track and highlights the spoken word in large type ("surgery," in guide-en-phone.png, "despues" in guide-es-phone.png, "天后，" in guide-zh-Hans-phone.png). No clipped or cut-off caption text in any of the six guide screenshots.

The toc fact lists seven chapters, each seek landing exactly on its expected start (0, 9.76, 30.56, 54.64, 68.08, 88.16, 114.56 s) with the right chapter marked active, and every chapter visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. guide-en-desktop.png and the es and zh-Hans desktop shots show all seven titles with times in a left-hand list, chapter 1 highlighted; at phone width the picker reads "CHAPTER 1 OF 7" with back, forward and a dropdown chevron (guide-en-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png), which a patient can find and open.

The languages fact shows the Spanish and Mandarin pages carrying their own title, their own audio file under /assets/audio/v2/<lang>/, and the expected first sentence. The screenshots show no English left behind: guide-es-desktop.png is Spanish throughout (Idioma, Imprimir la tarjeta, TRANSCRIPCION, Reproducir, Velocidad, Subtitulos, LLAME PARA PEDIR AYUDA) and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png is Chinese throughout (语言, 打印卡片, 文字稿, 播放, 速度, 字幕, 打电话求助), chapter lists and captions included.

The provider_file fact records two steps, paste the block and copy the link, 39 ms from paste to link, no account or login fields and no network requests after load. provider-filled.png shows the filled block producing rows for Antibiotic, Pain medication, Follow-up and Language, each with the value taken from the note and "your block" in the From column, each still editable in place ("Change a value here and the matching line in your block changes too"), and "Open this patient's guide" live. guide-from-link.png shows the link honouring those values: Spanish page, the pain-medicine sentence present, the antibiotic sentence gone, and "Su revision de la herida y examen del oido: 1 de octubre de 2026" in the transcript. With the unfilled template (provider-draft.png) the four clinical rows read "Choose one" in red and the link is held back until the provider answers, with the follow-up preset offered as one click; that is a deliberate refusal to guess a medication from a *** placeholder, and the filled path a provider actually uses stays well under a minute.

The review_line fact shows one line in the block, "Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***", no clinician badge and no review date in the link. The page tells the truth about it: provider-draft.png says "Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line" and provider-filled.png says "Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link. It stays in your note." The link fragment is #a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es, with no review date, and guide-from-link-badges.png, scrolled to the end of the transcript, shows chapter 7 ending with no reviewer line or badge.

The card_summary fact reports the card on the first screen at both widths and the card itself returning 200. "Print the card" sits in the header at desktop width (guide-en-desktop.png, and its Spanish and Mandarin equivalents Imprimir la tarjeta and 打印卡片), and at 375x812 it sits just under the player controls, above the fold, in all three languages (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png). One tap either way.
